messages.subject: CPD: Liability caps and exclusions in tech contracts – 5 Nov lunch session
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

A reminder that our autumn CPD lunch session, 'Drafting effective limitation of liability clauses in technology agreements', takes place on 5 November at 12:30 in the Bishopsgate training room. 1 hour CPD. Sandwiches provided. Please register via the L&D portal.

WC Learning & Development
